hypothesis: The specificity of Cas9 is determined by complementarity between the guide RNA and target DNA sequence
prediction: The number of mismatches between guide RNA and target DNA will correlate with cleavage efficiency
measurement_method: Compare cleavage efficiency of Cas9 with guide RNAs having varying numbers of mismatches to the same target sequence
falsification_condition: Cleavage efficiency remains constant regardless of mismatch number or increases with more mismatches
